title: shadcn/ui
notes: One of the references that shaped Scout's own tenets (§3.5) — kept in the pack for the irony as much as the utility.
summary: Copy-in, ownable component recipes built on Radix primitives and Tailwind. Not a dependency you install and forget — code you own and can edit.
surfaces_when: the feature needs a styled, accessible UI component (dialog, dropdown, form control, etc.)
the project already uses Tailwind and wants consistent component patterns
ambient_line: shadcn/ui — ownable component recipes on Radix + Tailwind.
